mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level is associated with a higher cost of capital, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, without requiring a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating condition, defined as the unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months, signals potential economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in household demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply chain disruption, measured by a 10% year-over-year decline in industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The INDPRO YoY decline > 10% condition does not result in negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annualized inflation rate above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals potential central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market, which triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to strong consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint growth in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, defined by the federal funds rate rising above 5.0% and remaining elevated, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: The monetary tightening cycle condition does not result in negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential construction permits (HOUST) is associated with stronger household demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, without requiring a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
